Grab yours until it sells. Description Warm your tone with the Vatra , the signature overdrive designed for Vlad Yarun of the Ukrainian Hutsul Metal pioneers, Karna . At its core, this pedal is a heavily cultivated take on the legendary Ibanez TS-808 , specifically tuned to tighten up high-gain amplifiers and deliver the percussive attack. We’ve equipped the Vatra with a two-way toggle switch to offer distinct voices: Smereka mode delivers the classic, focused mid-range of a standard 808, perfect for cutting through a dense mix. Flip to Buk mode to engage MOSFET clipping, which adds a grittier texture and reintroduces significantly more low-end presence for a massive, full-bodied sound. Whether you are boosting a crunch channel or sculpting a lead tone, Vatra brings the heat. Controls Drive - gain level. Tone - active lowpass filter control. Level - output volume. Mode toggle - Smereka (delivers the classic, focused mid-range of a standard 808) and Buk (MOSFET clipping with added low-end presence). LED brightness trimmer - placed on the PCB, the trimmer allows you to adjust the status LED brightness. About the name "Vatra" translates to "bonfire" in Ukrainian—a perfect metaphor for a pedal built to act as a heater for your tube amp, pushing it into saturation. The name is also a direct nod to the powerful Karna song of the same name. Keeping with the Hutsul spirit, the mode switch positions are named after trees native to the Ukrainian Carpathian mountains: Smereka (Spruce) and Buk (Beech), the very woods used to fuel the fire. Power supply 9-18V DC adapter (Boss-style negative center) not included. No batteries. They are bad for the environment 🌲. sources.excerpt: Guitar Pedal X - GPX Blog - Drunk Beaver delivers Dual-Voice Vatra Signature High Gain Amp Booster Overdrive for Vlad Yarun, guitarist for Ukrainian 'Hutsul Metal' band Karna ao link News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Xploration • Curation • Recommendation News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Filter content by area of interest Amps Boost and Overdrive Delay Distortion Fuzz Guitars Modulation Pitch Reverb Utility All All Drunk Beaver delivers Dual-Voice Vatra Signature High Gain Amp Booster & Overdrive for Vlad Yarun, guitarist for Ukrainian 'Hutsul Metal' band Karna Jan 16, 2026 08:00 by Stefan Karlsson Boost Boost and Overdrive Drunk Beaver Overdrive Tubescreamer Style Overdrive + - Full Article Read Summary Key Points The Drunk Beaver Vatra is a Dual-Voice Boost / Overdrive derived from the Ibanez TS808. The Upper “Smereka” mode provides classic Tube Screamer-style clipping and Level, Tone, and Drive controls; the Down “Buk” MOSFET clipping mode is grittier, louder, thicker, bassier, and punchier. Custom developed for Vlad Yarun of Ukrainian “Hutsul Metal” band Karna, it is used with Buk Level at Max, Tone at 4 o’clock, and Drive around 12:30. The Drunk Beaver Rocks Webstore price is $150. What we have here is a Dual-Voice Boost / Overdrive derived from the Ibanez TS808. The toggle switch selects the two voicings - where the Upper ’Smereka’ Mode is a classic TS808 style Tube Screamer. Flip the switch Down to ’BUK’ MOSFET clipping Mode for a grittier, louder, thicker, bassier and punchier voicing. The classic Smerek voicing is pretty much exactly as you would expect - and you have the classic 3 x screamer controls - Level, Tone, and Drive. For me the ’Buk’ Mode is a revelation - a really distinct fuller flavour which wholly sounds exceptional. If you already have a favourite Tube Screamer - it’s totally worth it to get this Vatra - just for the ’Buk’ Mode - which is genuinely different. I tend to live mostly on the 'Buk' mode - with Level @ Max, Tone @ 4 o'c, and Drive at circa 12:30 o'c. I really like the classic TS808 setting too - while the 'Buk' setting is somewhat special! The Vatra was custom developed for guitarist Vlad Yarun of the Ukrainian 'Hutsul Metal' pioneers Karna. Where Hutsul Metal is a unique genre of Folk / Nomad infused Metal - usually highly melodic. The Vatra Boost / Overdrive goes for $150 on the Drunk Beaver Rocks Webstore , it's one of my favourite Drunk Beaver Overdrive voicings to date, in fact one of my favourite Overdrives out of all of them - and is well worth your consideration! I tend to have mine fairly cranked for the most flavour and texture - the 'Buk' voicing really is pretty spectacular!
